itemdesc-mosssigil: A pad of pressed living moss. Right-click to write a small circle on it, hold right-click to cast it, sneak + right-click to edit it.
itemdesc-barkstrip: A thin strip of bark. Right-click to write a circle on it, hold right-click to cast it, sneak + right-click to edit it.
itemdesc-parchment: A scraped, stretched sheet of hide. Room for a full circle with its aim ring. Right-click to write on it, hold right-click to cast it, sneak + right-click to edit it.
canvas-hint:
Circle: click a slot to select it, drag between two glyphs to link them, drag with right-click to unlink them, scroll over a glyph to write it more or less strongly, click the border to choose where its life comes from.
Glyph: hold and sweep across points to draw, sweep with right-click to erase. Click a point to cycle its mark, right-click to clear it.
canvas-empty: Write at least one glyph before inscribing.
inscribe-no-medium: Hold what you want to write on.
cast-cooldown: Your hand is still trembling from the last working.
cast-fizzle: The circle smoulders and crumbles. Nothing answers.
cast-backfire: The elements fight each other and the circle bursts in your hand!
command-inspect: Show how the server reads the circle on the medium in your hand (spoilers!)
command-glyphs: Open a window showing this world's glyphs (spoilers!)
error-in-game-only: Run this in game, not from the console.
error-script-not-ready: The world's script is not ready yet.
inspect-out-of-bounds: Out of bounds for this tier: casting does nothing.
